nodes.label: Apply this switch? It removes .wolven-harness/ and adds tracked files at the root.
nodes.note: Shown under the diff, which also moves your edited or added skills, rules and hooks to the root and removes the quiet install's symlinks, hooks, ignore lines and harness block. If a root path is in the way, or a symlink into .wolven-harness/ may not be the harness's, it stops first: "Nothing changed." and what to do next.

nodes.label: Full install

sections.head: What happens
items: Docs and your edited or added files move to the root; the rest of .wolven-harness/ goes
The quiet install's symlinks, hooks, ignore lines and harness block are removed
setup reruns and writes the root scaffold
harness-init checks nothing still points into .wolven-harness/, then carries on with its full-install flow

nodes.label: Which harness folders should git track?
nodes.sub: Ticked folders get committed, and your client sees them. Unticked ones stay on this machine and don't reach worktrees. The harness AGENTS.md is always tracked.

items.label: Decision records (ADRs)
items.hint: Why the code is the way it is. They keep your agent's context accurate over the long run, so keep them current

nodes.label: How should we ignore the harness local-only files?
Add the harness block to AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md?
nodes.note: Tracked change; AGENTS.md is created if missing. A lean marked block of at most three lines, the same in both files

options.label: No
options.hint: Those tools stay not set up, and doctor names them

nodes.label: You already have .claude/skills/code-commit, and it stays as it is. For the harness's code-commit: merge it into yours, save it next to yours as wolven-code-commit, or skip it?
nodes.note: Asked once per occupied path, before the wiring diff; skipped when nothing is occupied. A real .claude/skills/ folder is kept, and the harness adds one symlink per skill inside it. Each outcome goes in .wolven-harness/wiring.json for doctor and later runs

options.label: Merge into mine
options.hint: Merged text shows in the wiring diff; a tracked change when the path is tracked

nodes.label: Create the harness symlinks for Claude Code?
nodes.note: The diff lists each symlink (one per skill and per rule), the Claude Code hooks it sets up, the ignore lines (the harness-init symlink included) and any tracked change, such as .dockerignore. When a tool can't read a piece from a file only on this machine (Amp, OpenCode, Copilot on GitHub, Gemini with its own GEMINI.md), the diff offers the tracked edit that would, Yes or No; Codex gets a manual step

nodes.label: Commit these 6 files to feature/x? Nothing is pushed.
nodes.note: One offer for the whole run, listing only files git would track, each tagged tracked or new. Ignored symlinks are never force-added; the closing lists them as staying on this machine, plus every path kept as yours. The session note is in it only if Notes is ticked. With no remote it says: "This repo has no remote, so there is nothing to commit for."
